text:
Maria Gonzalez: Quick check — BrightAudit fieldwork starts next Wed. Are we set on the evidence handoff for encryption controls (KMS/HSM) and the audit-log retention mapping?
Ajit Patel: Working on the retention mapping doc now. I need confirmation of final owners for: key rotation evidence, HSM attestations, and ingestion of auditor logs.
Kevin O'Neill: I can own key rotation evidence (control ENC-1). Will hand over the runbook and rotation logs. ETA: end of day Tuesday.
Lia Chen: I'll take HSM attestations (ENC-3). Lia -> will sync with infra team tomorrow and confirm whether the HSM vendor can produce the attestation PDF.
Samir Rao: For audit-log ingestion (AUD-5), is this the cloudtrail + internal app logs pipeline? I can validate the pipeline but need a dev point to surface logs from on-prem collector.
Ajit Patel: Yes Samir — cloudtrail + app logs + the on-prem collector (collector-prod). @Kevin can you add the KMS key usage export to the collector so auditors can see key IDs and usage?
Kevin O'Neill: Sure. I'll add a daily export to S3 of key-usage summary. Patch for rotation evidence:
```bash
# generate rotation evidence archive
aws kms list-keys --profile redwood-prod > /tmp/kms-keys.json
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id <id> >> /tmp/rotation-status.log
aws s3 cp /tmp/rotation-*.log s3://redwood-audit-evidence/kms/$(date +%F)/
```
Lia Chen: FYI vendor said HSM attestation might take 3-5 business days. I'll request expedited if needed. Do we have a temporary fallback evidence path?
Maria Gonzalez: If the vendor can't deliver, we'll accept a signed letter + HSM access logs for the period (from collector). Need @Samir to confirm log visibility.
Samir Rao: I can surface HSM access logs to the same S3 bucket, but note they include some sensitive fields — we'll mask identifiers before handing over. Add to pipeline tasks.
Ajit Patel: Ownership list so far: ENc-1 -> Kevin, ENC-3 -> Lia, AUD-5 -> Samir. I'll put this into the control tracker spreadsheet and tag owners.
Maria Gonzalez: Milestones reminder: evidence bundle freeze = Tue EOD (one day before fieldwork). If any owner misses freeze, we escalate to the security lead and bring in backups.
Kevin O'Neill: Quick question on backups — if rotation logs are small, do we compress/pgp before uploading? Compliance prefers encryption at rest + signed archive.
Lia Chen: We should PGP-sign the archive and ensure S3 bucket has server-side encryption + restricted ACLs. I can add a presigned listing for auditors.
Samir Rao: I'll add a Lambda to scrub PII from collector logs before the evidence bucket. Plan: filter -> redact -> put into /redwood-audit-evidence/collector/$(date)/
Ajit Patel: Two dependency flags: 1) infra needs an ACL change to let auditors access a read-only role. @eng-infra sign-off? 2) legal needs to approve the attestation letter template if vendor takes fallback path.
Maria Gonzalez: Noted. I've pinged @legal and @eng-infra. If infra change is blocked, we will hand over via temporary signed S3 URLs and rotate them after the session.
Security Bot: Deploy log: collector-prod:build-2026.03.15 pushed -> staging. No errors detected.
Kevin O'Neill: One more: confirm whether KMS keys used by Dedicated region XX are included in the export (we have cross-region keys). I'll add a filter to include all customer regions.
Ajit Patel: Good catch. Add cross-region list to the runbook.
Lia Chen: I'll update the HSM attestation checklist in Confluence and link to the runbook once Kevin uploads rotation evidence.
Maria Gonzalez: Perfect. Action items summary:
- Kevin: rotation evidence export + cross-region include (due Tue EOD)
- Lia: escalate vendor attestation + update Confluence checklist (due Tue midday)
- Samir: pipeline scrub + confirm collector visibility (due Tue EOD)
- Ajit: update control tracker + coordinate infra/legal (ongoing)
If anything slips, shout here and we'll reassign. :thumbsup:
Ajit Patel: I'll make a final owners call on Monday and post the spreadsheet link.
Kevin O'Neill: A note for auditors — sampling window = Jan 1 -> Mar 31 2026. I'll include that in the evidence manifest.
Lia Chen: If vendor needs PO or SOW signature to release attestation, I'll escalate to procurement.
Samir Rao: Adding a sanity check job to run tonight to ensure collector -> s3 path is healthy. Will post results here.
Maria Gonzalez: Thanks team — appreciate the quick turn. We'll reconvene Mon AM async check.
Samir Rao: cron job succeeded: collector -> s3 upload OK, 0 errors (verified at 1769966400).
